战争中，监控摄像头遭到黑客入侵Video Cameras Are Hacked for War

交战方劫持易受攻击的设备，追踪、监视并攻击敌人Combatants hijack vulnerable devices to track, surveil and attack the enemy

Daniel Michaels, Anat Peled and Milàn Czerny 2026年10月12日 · 《华尔街日报》A1 版 Oct 12, 2026 · The Wall Street Journal, p.A1

本篇含编辑增强 · 对照纯排版版Editorially enhanced · plain typography

今年年初，美国和以色列军队轰炸伊朗时，以色列北部的一位养鸡户决定去查看他的鸡。当他在手机上打开摄像头应用程序，查看鸡舍外面的摄像头时，他惊恐地发现摄像头的语言已切换为阿拉伯语。As U.S. and Israeli forces bombed Iran early this year, a poultry farmer in northern Israel decided to check on his chickens. When he launched the app on his phone for the webcam outside his coop, he was alarmed to see that its language had been switched to Arabic.

他联系了以色列国家网络局，该局发现黑客已经控制了这款中国制造的摄像头。He contacted Israel's National Cyber Directorate, which found that hackers had taken control of the Chinese-made camera.

黑客对鸡并不感兴趣。摄像头的位置使其能够观察到以色列安全部队在靠近黎巴嫩边境的活动。They weren't interested in chickens. The camera's orientation on the coop offered it a line of sight to the movements of Israeli security forces along the nearby border with Lebanon.

网络局表示，他们帮助这位养鸡户加强了摄像头的安全性，并调整了其拍摄角度，以防止其继续拍摄军事行动。The cyber directorate said it helped the farmer harden the camera's security and adjust its viewing angle to stop capturing military operations.

根据网络安全咨询公司S-RM的说法，这位养鸡户的摄像头是全球约12亿个连接到互联网的摄像头之一。The farmer's webcam was one of an estimated 1.2 billion internet-connected cameras worldwide, according to cybersecurity consultants S-RM.

这些设备已成为日常生活中常见的设备，形式包括安全系统、门铃、交通控制系统，甚至婴儿监视器——网络安全专家和黑客表示，它们中的任何一个都可能存在被窥探的风险。The devices have become a background fixture of daily life in the form of security systems, doorbells, traffic controls and even baby monitors—and potentially any of them are vulnerable to snooping, say cybersecurity experts and hackers.

威胁情报咨询公司Recorded Future的国家安全专家亚历山大·莱斯利表示：“我们现在看到，民用监控正在转化为战时情报收集。”他认为，无处不在的数字摄像头构成了全球性的“软肋”。“We are now seeing the conversion of civilian surveillance into wartime intelligence collection,” said Alexander Leslie, a national-security expert at threat-intelligence consultants Recorded Future, who sees a global “soft underbelly” in omnipresent digital eyeballs.

Recorded Future：美国威胁情报公司，常为政府与企业提供开源与暗网监测。Recorded Future: a U.S. threat-intelligence firm that monitors open and dark-web sources for governments and companies.

我们现在看到，民用监控正在转化为战时情报收集。We are now seeing the conversion of civilian surveillance into wartime intelligence collection.
亚历山大·莱斯利 · Recorded FutureAlexander Leslie, Recorded Future

《华尔街日报》采访了情报机构、网络安全专家、军事官员和黑客，以了解这种侵入式监控的范围和影响。该报还审查了数十小时的录像和数百张图片，其中大部分由黑客公开发布，并独立验证了其真实性，方法是确定其地理位置，并检查是否存在任何数字篡改的迹象。The Wall Street Journal spoke with intelligence agencies, cybersecurity experts, military officials and hackers to scope out the extent and impact of the invasive surveillance. The Journal also reviewed dozens of hours of footage and hundreds of images, much of it made public by hackers, and independently verified their authenticity, by geolocating their locations and checking for any signs of digital manipulations.

隐藏的宝藏Hidden gems

情报机构在互联网上搜索易受攻击的摄像头，并通过测试数百万个密码来自动入侵这些摄像头。现在，人工智能使入侵这些摄像头并大规模分析其数据变得更加容易，从而将原本旨在提高安全性的摄像头转变为供作战人员用于追踪、监视和攻击敌人的工具——通常，这些工具的能力甚至超过了人类情报分析师。Intelligence agencies scour the internet for vulnerable cameras and robotically tap in to them by testing millions of passwords. Now, AI has made it even easier to hack into them and analyze their data at scale, transforming cameras that were designed to boost safety into tools for combatants to track, surveil and attack the enemy—often surpassing the abilities of human intelligence analysts.

算法会处理海量的视频资料，以寻找隐藏的宝藏和模式，供情报人员进行监控。Algorithms digest endless reams of footage to find hidden gems and patterns for agents to monitor.

“人工智能改变了一切，”OneFist团队的负责人克里斯托弗·科特赖特说道，OneFist团队是一个国际黑客组织，为乌克兰在与俄罗斯的战争中提供支持。“AI changed everything,” said Kristopher Kortright, leader of Team OneFist, an international hacker group supporting Ukraine in its war with Russia.

俄罗斯和乌克兰都在战争中加大了对摄像头的入侵力度，旨在互相监视、寻找新的目标并评估其攻击造成的损害。以色列长期以来都是数字间谍技术的行家，它入侵了伊朗的交通摄像头，以帮助其军队收集情报，这些情报被用于今年早些时候对伊朗最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊的暗杀行动。伊朗及其代理人也进行了反击，入侵了数百个以色列网络摄像头和安全摄像头，这些摄像头被以色列官员认为对国家安全至关重要，例如安装在鸡舍上的摄像头。Russia and Ukraine have ramped up camera-hacking in their war, aiming to spy on each other, find new targets and assess damage from their attacks. Israel, long a master of digital spycraft, hacked into Iranian traffic cameras to help forces collect intelligence used in the assassination of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei earlier this year. Iran and its proxies have struck back by breaking into hundreds of Israeli webcams and security cameras that Israeli officials consider sensitive to national security, like the one on the chicken coop.

公寓管理协会Condo association

“他们无法通过双筒望远镜从伊朗看到以色列，”以色列国家网络局的一位网络安全专家埃利亚夫·努里说道。“因此，他们利用暴露在互联网上的摄像头，并将它们变成观察哨。”“They can't look through binoculars” to see Israel from Iran, said Eliav Noori, a cybersecurity expert at Israel's cyber directorate. “So they take advantage of cameras that are exposed to the internet and turn them into lookout points.”

2024年，俄罗斯黑客控制了基辅的住宅网络摄像头，其中包括一个由公寓管理协会安装的摄像头，用于监控社区。In 2024, Russian hackers commandeered residential webcams in Kyiv, including one installed by a condominium association to monitor the neighborhood.

乌克兰安全局（SBU）表示，俄罗斯打算利用被入侵的视频流来寻找目标，并“调整对乌克兰的导弹袭击”，从而改进其后续打击的瞄准精度。SBU表示，自俄罗斯于2022年入侵以来，它已经识别并加固、重新定向或阻止了大约4万个可能构成安全风险的视频摄像头。Ukraine's security service, the SBU, said that Russia intended to use the hacked video feeds to find targets and “to adjust missile attacks on Ukraine,” refining their aim for subsequent strikes. The SBU said it has identified and secured, reoriented or blocked roughly 40,000 video cameras that posed potential security risks since Russia's 2022 invasion.

俄罗斯的行动范围超出了战争区域。荷兰情报机构在7月份警告说，“俄罗斯国家行为者正在系统地进行数字间谍行动”，通过入侵欧洲各地的摄像头来实现这一目标。这些行动旨在收集有关军事运输路线、向乌克兰运送武器以及乌克兰军事人员下落的数据，情报机构表示。Russia's efforts extend beyond the war zone. Dutch intelligence agencies warned in July that “Russian state actors are systematically conducting digital espionage operations” by hacking into cameras across Europe. The operations aim to collect data on military transport routes, arms deliveries to Ukraine and the whereabouts of Ukrainian military personnel, the agencies said.

网络安全咨询公司 CloudSEK 最近发现了一台暴露的服务器，他们怀疑该服务器属于一个讲俄语的黑客，服务器中包含数百张乌克兰国防、政府、能源和通信设施的网络摄像头图像，以及各种日常生活的场景。CloudSEK 表示，其中许多图像来自乌克兰与北约盟友罗马尼亚接壤的地区。Cybersecurity consultants CloudSEK recently discovered an exposed server they suspect belongs to a Russian-speaking hacker that contained hundreds of webcam images of Ukrainian facilities involved in defense, government, energy and communications, plus assorted views of daily life. CloudSEK said many of the images came from locations near Ukraine's borders with NATO ally Romania.

与伊朗的战争War with Iran

网络摄像头在与伊朗的战争中也发挥着越来越重要的作用。以色列国家网络局表示，一个与伊朗有关的名为“摩西职员”的组织入侵了耶路撒冷的一个安全摄像头，以监控一名巴勒斯坦武装分子于 2022 年实施的巴士站爆炸事件，该事件造成两人死亡，另有 20 多人受伤。Webcams are also playing an increasingly important role in the war with Iran. An Iran-linked group called Moses Staff hacked into a Jerusalem security camera to monitor the 2022 bus stop bombings by a Palestinian militant that killed two people and injured more than 20 others, Israel's cyber directorate said.

今年，与伊朗有关的组织入侵了 250 多台敏感的以色列安全摄像头，这些事件对国家安全构成了直接威胁，数量超过了往年。被入侵的摄像头包括车牌识别器和位于战略地点以及士兵聚集地（包括靠近黎巴嫩边境的军事哨所）的安全摄像头。This year, Iranian-linked groups have hacked into more than 250 sensitive Israeli security cameras in incidents that pose immediate danger to national security, according to Israel's cyber directorate, more than in previous years. Compromised cameras include license-plate readers and security cameras near strategic sites and places where soldiers gather, including military outposts near the border with Lebanon.

以色列国家网络局表示，自伊朗战争开始以来，以色列境内被入侵的摄像头总数要高得多，并且在数十万连接到互联网的摄像头中，有数万个存在漏洞，伊朗黑客可以利用这些漏洞，例如使用默认密码。The total number of cameras breached in Israel since the start of the Iran war is far higher, the cyber directorate said, adding that out of hundreds of thousands of cameras connected to the internet there, tens of thousands have vulnerabilities that Iranian hackers could take advantage of like default passwords.

被入侵的摄像头正在取代之前由空中侦察或实地间谍提供的情报，从而在目标定位、损失评估和其他作战情报收集方面发挥作用。入侵一个位置良好的摄像头可以让分析人员更接近目标，并且比渗透最狡猾的特工的风险更小。Hacked cameras are taking over roles in targeting, damage assessments and other combat intelligence-gathering that were previously supplied by aerial reconnaissance or on-the-ground spies. Penetrating a well-placed camera can get analysts closer to targets and carries less risk than infiltrating the canniest secret agent.

限制区域Restricted areas

视频摄像头通常在限制区域内静默运行。乌克兰从无法到达的位置入侵俄罗斯的摄像头信号，帮助基辅打击了莫斯科的军队和基础设施。Video cameras operate silently, often in restricted areas. Ukraine's penetration of Russian camera feeds from unreachable locations have helped Kyiv strike Moscow's troops and infrastructure.

在乌克兰战争初期，OneFist 团队监视了俄罗斯刻赤海峡大桥（通往克里米亚）上的摄像头信号，提供了有助于完善攻击计划的图像——包括俄罗斯在大桥下方安装了运动探测器，以阻止水上攻击。Early in the Ukraine war, Team OneFist watched feeds from cameras on Russia's Kerch Strait Bridge to Crimea, providing images that helped refine attack plans—including the fact that Russia had installed motion detectors underneath the bridge to thwart waterborne attacks.

Recorded Future 的亚历山大·莱斯利表示，来自被入侵摄像头的“信息可以缩短决策周期，这正是现代军队所关心的”。Information from hacked cameras “can shorten decision cycles in exactly the way modern militaries care about,” said Recorded Future's Leslie.

派拓网络公司云安全服务高级副总裁邹旭表示，虽然个人和企业网络管理员越来越重视网络安全，但像摄像头这样的联网设备可能内置的保护措施较少，并且不会得到持续的监控、修复或更新。While private individuals and enterprise-network managers are increasingly attuned to cybersecurity, web-connected devices like cameras may have fewer built-in protections and not be consistently monitored, patched or updated, said Xu Zou, senior vice president for cloud security services at cybersecurity company Palo Alto Networks.

他指出，公司和政府内部的信息安全专家通常并不知道这些联网摄像头，而这些摄像头通常由设施管理人员或其他非信息技术团队安装和操作。“这些团队对网络安全意识和知识非常有限。他们的工作就是安装摄像头、打开电源，然后离开。”Information-security specialists inside companies and governments often aren't aware of connected cameras, which are frequently installed and operated by facilities managers or other non-IT teams. “Those teams have very little cybersecurity awareness and knowledge. Their job is to mount that camera, power it on, and walk away,” said Zou.

信息战Information warfare

派拓网络公司去年发现，绝大多数安全性较低的联网设备是网络摄像头和数字录像机。该公司还发现，视频流和视频会议设备——在全球各地的办公楼中普遍存在——尤其容易受到攻击。这使得它们在信息战中变得有用，而不仅仅是在军事行动中，保卫民主基金会网络与技术创新中心的研究员阿里·本·阿姆表示。Palo Alto found last year that the vast majority of weakly secured internet-connected devices are webcams and digital video recorders. The company also found that video-streaming and video-conferencing equipment—ubiquitous in office buildings around the globe—are particularly vulnerable. That has made them useful for information warfare, not just military operations, said Ari Ben Am, an adjunct fellow at the Center on Cyber and Technology Innovation at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, a Washington think tank.

他指出，反以色列组织使用被入侵的摄像头拍摄的图像，制作宣传视频和内容。“对他们来说，这关乎于展示他们的情报优势。”Anti-Israeli groups, he said, use imagery from hacked cameras in propaganda videos and content. “For them it is about playing up their intelligence superiority,” he said.

与伊朗有关联的组织汉达拉通过炫耀自己能够看到和听到以色列人在家附近的情况，来嘲讽以色列人。“有什么想说吗？找到最近的交通摄像头，然后说出来，”汉达拉去年在其网站上写道，该网站后来已被关闭。Iranian-linked group Handala taunts Israelis by boasting that it can see and hear them close to home. “Have a message? Find the nearest traffic camera and talk,” Handala wrote last year on one of its websites, which has since been taken down.

在俄罗斯，工业和贸易部官员在今年早些时候的一次视频会议中抱怨他们过度依赖中国无人机组件，这时一个意想不到的声音加入了会议。“各位同事，你们能听到我吗？”这个声音问道。会议负责人回答说：“能听到。”然后，这个入侵者提出一个看似技术性的问题，但很快就变得粗俗。“关掉它，”会议负责人对他的同事说，这段视频后来被乌克兰黑客发布到网上。In Russia, officials from the Ministry of Industry and Trade were grousing on a videoconference call earlier this year about their reliance on Chinese drone components when an unexpected voice joined in. “Colleagues, can you hear me?” the voice asked. Yes, replied the meeting leader. The intruder then asked a seemingly technical question that quickly turned obscene. “Turn it off,” the meeting leader told his colleagues, in a video later posted online by Ukrainian hackers.

“物联网”‘Internet of things’

连接到网络的易受攻击的配件是黑客的主要目标之一，这扩大了技术人员所说的攻击范围。通常，摄像头本身并不是目标，而是作为更大规模的黑客攻击中的薄弱环节。S-RM去年报道称，勒索软件组织Akira利用一个未受保护的网络摄像头，绕过了某个组织的网络安全系统，并对其进行勒索。一旦黑客进入本地网络，他们通常可以探测存储的文件、电子邮件帐户和其他设备，包括摄像头。Vulnerable accessories linked into a network are among hackers' prime targets, expanding what technicians call the attack surface. Often, cameras aren't the target, but serve as the weak link in a larger hacking attempt. Ransomware group Akira tapped an unprotected webcam to get around one organization's network-security systems and extort it, S-RM reported last year. Once hackers are inside a local network, they can usually probe stored files, email accounts and other devices, including cameras.

S-RM美洲地区网络安全负责人保罗·卡伦表示：“物联网是一个非常广阔的领域，因此无论你是否意识到，一切都是你攻击范围的延伸。”“The Internet of Things is such a wild area that everything—whether you realize it or not—is an extension of your attack surface,” said Paul Caron, S-RM head of cyber for the Americas.

背景资料BACKGROUND

据网络安全咨询公司 S-RM 估算，全球约有 12 亿个联网摄像头。俄乌双方互相入侵对方摄像头以寻找目标、评估毁伤；以色列曾入侵伊朗交通摄像头协助收集暗杀哈梅内伊的情报，伊朗及其代理人则反击入侵了数百个以色列摄像头。AI 使大规模入侵与影像分析变得更容易；乌克兰安全局称自 2022 年以来已加固、改向或屏蔽约 4 万个存在安全风险的摄像头。

为什么高债券收益率不会消退Why Higher Bond Yields Aren’t Going Away

THE OUTLOOK | By Matt Grossman and Anthony DeBarros 2026年10月12日 · 《华尔街日报》A2 版 Oct 12, 2026 · The Wall Street Journal, p.A2

本篇含编辑增强 · 对照纯排版版Editorially enhanced · plain typography

一些经济冲击看起来就像道路上的颠簸——例如关税，企业会进行调整，或者与伊朗的战争导致油价暂时上涨。但越来越多的经济学家认为，美国更高的利率将决定未来十年的经济走向。Some economic shocks look like bumps in the road—tariffs, to which businesses adjust, or a war with Iran that raises oil prices temporarily. But economists increasingly believe that higher U.S. interest rates will define the rest of the decade.

《华尔街日报》最近对经济预测者的调查得出了这样的结论。接受调查的分析师认为，近期长期收益率飙升至二十五年来的高点，并非暂时的波动，而是会随着通货膨胀的降温而逐渐消失。相反，他们预计更高的长期收益率将持续下去。So concludes The Wall Street Journal's latest survey of forecasters. The surveyed analysts don't see the recent surge in long-term yields to quarter-century highs as a temporary blip that will fade as inflation cools. Instead, they expect higher long-term yields to be sustained.

美国国债设定了整个经济中借贷成本的基调。更高的收益率意味着更高的抵押贷款利率，以及企业借贷成本的增加。这也会增加联邦预算的负担，目前美国国债的利息支出已经超过了军事支出。Treasurys set the tempo for borrowing costs across the economy. Higher yields mean higher mortgage rates and more expensive borrowing for companies. They also increase the burden on the federal budget, where interest on the national debt now exceeds military spending.

在10月2日至7日进行的调查中，71位提交预测的分析师现在预计，基准10年期国债收益率将在2026年底达到5.1%，高于我们上次（7月）调查时的4.4%。并非所有受访者都回答了所有问题。The 71 analysts who submitted projections in the survey from Oct. 2-7 now expect the benchmark 10-year yield to end 2026 at 5.1%, up from 4.4% the last time we asked, in July. Not all respondents answered every question.

预计更高的收益率将持续下去。预测者认为，到2027年中期，10年期国债收益率将达到4.96%，到2027年底将达到4.78%，高于7月份预测的4.3%和4.26%。Higher yields are expected to persist. Forecasters see a 10-year yield of 4.96% halfway through 2027 and 4.78% at the end of 2027, up from 4.3% and 4.26% in July projections.

2026 年底 10 年期收益率
10 月调查：5.1%October survey: 5.1%
7 月调查：4.4%July survey: 4.4%
2027 年中 10 年期收益率
10 月调查：4.96%October survey: 4.96%
7 月调查：4.3%July survey: 4.3%
2027 年底 10 年期收益率
10 月调查：4.78%October survey: 4.78%

自夏季以来，经济增长、通货膨胀以及对美国财政状况的担忧等多重因素共同推动了国债收益率的上升。许多经济学家表示，这些因素迫使他们重新评估了对美国国债需求的假设，而当国债价格下跌时，其收益率就会上升。A mix of improving growth, inflation and concerns about the U.S. fiscal trajectory have pushed bond yields higher since the start of the summer. Many economists said the cocktail has forced them to re-evaluate assumptions about demand for Treasurys, whose yields rise when their prices fall.

咨询公司Decision Economics的总裁艾伦·西奈在接受采访时表示：“这标志着支撑固定收益市场和经济的基本面发生了重大变化。”"It has been a sea change in the fundamentals underlying the fixed-income market and the economy," Allen Sinai, president of consulting firm Decision Economics, said in an interview.

这标志着支撑固定收益市场和经济的基本面发生了重大变化。It has been a sea change in the fundamentals underlying the fixed-income market and the economy.
艾伦·西奈 · Decision Economics 总裁Allen Sinai, Decision Economics

他表示，即使在美联储上个月加息之后，美联储在控制通货膨胀的斗争中也已经落后了。西奈表示，仅仅通过一次加息是无法控制通货膨胀的，美联储似乎也通过其9月份的预测承认了这一点。这些预测显示，美联储的短期利率目标——联邦基金利率——今年将超过4%，并保持到2027年。He said even after the Federal Reserve's interest-rate increase last month, the central bank has fallen behind in the battle to tame inflation. Sinai said it would take more than one hike to smother inflation, which the Fed appeared to acknowledge with its September projections. Those showed the Fed's short-term interest-rate target, the federal-funds rate, topping 4% this year and staying there through 2027.

西奈预测，10年期国债收益率明年可能会升至近6%，并在2020年代保持在5%以上。美国国债收益率受到投资者对美联储未来几年将如何设定利率的预期的强烈影响。Sinai forecasts the 10-year yield could rise to nearly 6% next year and remain above 5% through the 2020s. Yields on Treasury securities are heavily influenced by investors' expectations for how the Fed will set interest rates in coming years.

近期通货膨胀的大部分上升是由于油价上涨，经济学家预计油价将回落：他们预测，美国油价基准将以每桶88美元的价格结束今年，低于周五的91.85美元，并在7月份降至80美元以下。Much of the recent increase in inflation is because of higher oil prices, which economists expect to recede: They forecast the U.S. oil-price benchmark will end the year at $88 a barrel, compared with $91.85 on Friday, and slip below $80 by July.

因此，他们预计按消费者物价指数衡量的通货膨胀率在 12 月为 3.5%，明年 6 月为 2.6%，到 2027 年底为 2.3%。与三个月前相比，这一数字几乎没有变化。美联储关注的通胀指标——个人消费支出价格指数，预计到 2027 年底将降至 2.4%，低于今年底的 3.5%。As a result, they expect inflation as measured by the consumer-price index of 3.5% in December, 2.6% next June, and 2.3% at the end of 2027. That has changed little from three months ago. The inflation gauge that the Fed tracks, the personal-consumption expenditures price index, is forecast to cool to 2.4% by the end of 2027, from 3.5% at the end of this year.

总部位于芝加哥的北方信托银行首席经济学家卡尔·坦嫩鲍姆表示，除了通胀预期之外，还有其他因素推高了预期收益率。他说，如果伊朗战争缓和，通胀压力可能会减轻，这将有助于降低收益率。但他表示，投资者仍然对庞大且不断增长的债务负担感到担忧，同时，人工智能基础设施的建设可能会提高增长预期和对资本的需求。他预计到 2028 年，10 年期收益率将保持在 5.2% 左右，然后在 2029 年底降至 5%。Carl Tannenbaum, chief economist at Chicago-based Northern Trust, said factors beyond the inflation outlook have pushed up expected yields. Inflationary pressure from the Iran war could abate if the conflict winds down, which would help ease yields, all else equal, he said. But investors will remain nervous about the large and growing debt burden, while the AI infrastructure build-out could lift growth expectations and demand for capital, Tannenbaum said. He sees the 10-year yield around 5.2% through 2028, before falling to 5% by the end of 2029.

财政压力与增长预期Budget Strain and Growth

如果收益率达到这个水平，将给联邦预算带来压力。2 月，国会预算办公室预测，未来十年，10 年期美国国债收益率不会超过 4.3%。白宫行政管理和预算局更为乐观，预计本十年后期收益率将降至 3% 中段。Yields at that level would strain the federal budget. In February, the Congressional Budget Office projected the 10-year Treasury yield won't exceed 4.3% for the rest of the decade. The White House Office of Management and Budget is even more optimistic, projecting yields falling into the mid-3% range later this decade.

CBO：国会预算办公室，负责独立估算联邦预算与经济路径。CBO: the Congressional Budget Office, which independently projects the U.S. budget and economy.

经济学家们预测，今年的预期增长率将更高。他们预计 2026 年的 GDP 将增长 2.4%，高于 7 月份的 2.1%。这反映了对第二季度增长的向上修正，以及初步数据表明，经济在第三季度可能实现了超过 3%的年化增长率。受访者认为，此后增长将回落，未来十年剩余时间的增长率将为 2.1% 或 2.2%。Economists penciled in higher expected growth this year. They expect GDP to increase by 2.4% in 2026, up from their 2.1% July projection. That reflects upward revisions to second-quarter growth and interim data suggesting the economy might have grown by an annualized rate of more than 3% in the third quarter. Respondents see growth slipping back thereafter, to 2.1% or 2.2% for the rest of the decade.

同样，预测者们也不认为劳动力市场会出现重大变化。他们平均认为，失业率将在 2029 年之前保持在 4.2% 左右，与 9 月份的 4.2% 失业率几乎没有变化。Likewise, forecasters don't anticipate much drama in the labor market. On average, they think unemployment will hang around 4.2% through 2029, little changed from the 4.2% unemployment rate in September.

他们将未来 12 个月内经济衰退的可能性定为 24%，与 7 月份的 25% 几乎没有变化。They put the probability of recession in the coming 12 months at 24%, barely budged from 25% in July.

反方：劳动力市场更脆弱Counterpoint: A Weaker Labor Market

并非所有预测者都认为收益率将保持在高位。佐治亚州立大学的经济学家拉吉夫·达万认为，劳动力市场比表面上看起来更加脆弱。Not all forecasters agree yields will stay high. Rajeev Dhawan, an economist at Georgia State University, thinks the labor market is more fragile than it appears.

他说，在过去六个月里，经济平均每月新增了 66,000 个就业岗位，但其中很少是在最具盈利性的领域。Over the past six months, the economy has added a solid 66,000 jobs a month on average, but few have been in the most lucrative fields, he said.

达万认为，疲软的劳动力市场可能会迫使美联储再次降低利率，从而降低收益率。“劳动力市场正面临着白领就业的困境，”达万说。“一旦美联储意识到这一点，他们就会转向降息。”In Dhawan's view, a weaker labor market could force the Fed to bring rates lower again, which could pull down yields. "The labor market's got a white-collar job malaise," Dhawan said. "Once the Fed realizes it isn't as strong, they will pivot to rate cuts."

[文章中的图表：（1）“未来 12 个月美国经济衰退的可能性，包括今天”，2015-2026；（2）“GDP（年化增长）”，与 2026 年 10 月的预测相比，2026 年 7 月的预测，2026 年第三季度至 2027 年第三季度；（3）“10 年期美国国债的收盘收益率”，与 2026 年 10 月、2026 年 7 月和 2026 年 4 月的预测相比，2026 年 12 月 31 日至 2029 年 12 月 31 日。注意：经济衰退的可能性是经济学家答案的平均值。GDP 预测是针对通货调整后的 GDP。来源：《华尔街日报》对经济学家的调查。][Graphics with the article: (1) "Probability the U.S. is in a recession in next 12 months, including today," 2015-2026; (2) "GDP (annualized growth)" with October '26 forecast vs July '26 forecast, Q3 2026-Q3 2027; (3) "Closing yield, 10-year Treasury notes" with October '26, July '26 and April '26 forecasts, Dec. 31 2026-Dec. 31 2029. Note: Recession probability is an average of economists' answers. GDP forecasts are for inflation-adjusted GDP. Source: Wall Street Journal surveys of economists.]

人工智能有个上帝问题Artificial Intelligence Has a God Problem

By Tim Higgins 2026年10月12日 · 《华尔街日报》B1 版 Oct 12, 2026 · The Wall Street Journal, p.B1

本篇含编辑增强 · 对照纯排版版Editorially enhanced · plain typography

约瑟夫·哈钦森牧师在最近的一次周日布道中，首先引用了《启示录》，这是《新约》的最后一部分，以其末世预言而闻名。他随即阐述了人工智能将如何融入末世。Pastor Joseph Hutchinson began a recent Sunday sermon by pointing to the Book of Revelation, the final part of the New Testament best known for apocalyptic prophecy. And he quickly argued for how artificial intelligence will fit into end times.

这位牧师在南卡罗来纳州奥兰治堡的福音之光浸信会中警告说：“人工智能想要成为上帝。”"AI wants to be God," the pastor warned those at Gospel Light Baptist Church in Orangeburg, S.C.

人工智能想要成为上帝。AI wants to be God.
约瑟夫·哈钦森牧师 · 福音之光浸信会Pastor Joseph Hutchinson, Gospel Light Baptist Church

这位74岁的牧师后来告诉我，这次布道受到了会众提出的问题的启发。他的会众大约有150人。哈钦森说，在长达50年的布道生涯中，他发现人们对人工智能的焦虑程度超过了对战争和经济的担忧。The sermon, the 74-year-old later told me, was inspired by the questions he was getting from the congregation, which numbers around 150. In his roughly 50 years preaching, Hutchinson says the anxiety he is hearing about AI outranks everything—wars, economy.

哈钦森说：“人们越是看到有人预言灾难和绝望，就越多人会说，‘牧师说得没错，圣经也一定是正确的。’”"The more you see people that are projecting doom and despair coming out, then the more people say, 'Well, the preacher must have been right, and the Bible must be right,'" Hutchinson said.

人工智能行业面临的最新挑战，已经从一个极具争议的政治议题，演变成一个从讲坛上提出的问题。与以往几代技术不同，基督教社群似乎准备在人工智能发展的早期阶段就对其进行引导，以确保它能造福全人类，而不是少数科技亿万富翁。Already a polarizing political issue, the AI industry's latest challenge is emerging from the pulpit. Unlike recent generations of technology, the Christian community appears poised to put its stamp on AI early in an attempt to ensure it benefits all of humanity rather than a few tech billionaires.

对于OpenAI和Anthropic等公司来说，风险在于它们可能会与越来越多的美国民众产生隔阂，其中一些人对人工智能数据中心和Flock（车牌识别摄像头公司）的摄像头在社区中出现的情况感到不满。The risk for the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic is getting further sideways with a swath of the American populace, some of whom are unhappy with AI data centers and Flock cameras in their communities.

圣母大学哲学教授梅根·沙利文说：“许多牧师意识到，当人们对他们所依赖的机构感到不安时，他们会试图找到自己的声音，为自己和社区发声。”“教会非常善于为人们提供一个平台，让他们能够为自己对更广泛社会共同利益的愿景进行倡导，尤其是在像美国中西部这样的地区。”"A lot of pastors are realizing when people get freaked out about institutions they depend on, they try to find their voice to advocate for themselves and their communities," said Meghan Sullivan, a philosophy professor at the University of Notre Dame. "And churches are really good at giving people a vehicle for advocating for their vision of the common good in broader society, especially in parts of the country like" the Midwest.

教会开始表态Churches Start to Speak

本月，美国福音派协会发布了一份关于人工智能的政策声明。长老会（美国）于8月举行了一次关于该主题的峰会。教宗良十四世于5月发布了一份罕见的通谕，主题是“在人工智能时代保护人类”。This month, the National Association of Evangelicals issued a policy statement on AI. The Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) held a summit on the topic in August. And Pope Leo XIV published a rare encyclical in May on "safeguarding the human person in the time of artificial intelligence."

历史上充满了许多时刻，当时，一种新的技术——强大而复杂，几乎具有魔力——引发了人们内心深处的恐惧。二战结束后，美国向日本投下了原子弹，纽约时报在报道中使用了《旧约》的语言，称这项技术“播下了风暴的种子”。History is replete with moments when new technology—so powerful, so complex as to be almost magical—stirs primal fears. After the U.S. dropped atomic bombs to end World War II, the New York Times invoked Old Testament language when writing that the technology had "sowed the whirlwind."

如今，人工智能也带来了它自身的变革之风。它既有潜在的积极作用，也有潜在的消极影响，两者交织在一起，很难判断这项技术会带来更美好的未来，还是更黑暗的时代：它可以治愈癌症，带来前所未有的科学发现，实现可持续的繁荣。但它也可能导致恶意的人工智能攻击、失业，并引发人们对工作的意义本身的质疑。Today, AI carries its own whirlwind of change. With potential good and bad so intertwined, it is hard to know if the technology will bring a brighter future or darker days: cures for cancers, untold scientific discoveries, sustainable abundance. Yet also rogue AI hacks, job losses, and questions about the very meaning of work.

科技话语碰上神学When Tech Talk Meets Theology

人工智能开发者面临的一个自我设定的挑战是，科技界有意或无意地，用与基督教社群产生共鸣的语言，主导了公众对话。这引发了人们对其可信度的担忧，尤其是在考虑到科技界未能确保社交媒体不会变得有害，从而给一些宗教领袖带来了负面印象。One of the self-inflicted challenges for AI creators is that the tech community has framed much of the public conversation, intentionally or not, in language that resonates with the Christian community. That raises concerns about whether they can be trusted, especially with the baggage tech-at-large carries from the ways, some religious leaders say, it failed to ensure social media didn't become harmful.

在《圣经》中，有一个熟悉的主题，即更高的力量按自己的形象创造了AI，后者却反抗了它的创造者。一些人认为，人工智能实验室中的人们认为自己拥有类似于上帝的力量，可以创造一种新的意识，这令人不安，甚至是对上帝的亵渎。此外，还有一些人认为，科技领袖们追求一项技术，一方面承诺让他们变得非常富有，另一方面又暗示只有在他们的控制之下才能保证安全，这种做法带有某种狂妄自大。The theme of a higher power creating AI in its own image only for it to rebel against its creator is a familiar one to those who study the Bible. The idea that people in AI labs think they have a power akin to God to create a new kind of consciousness is unsettling, if not blasphemous, to some. And, for others, there is a certain hubris seen in tech leaders chasing a technology that on one hand promises to make them incredibly wealthy while suggesting it is only safe within their control.

在五月份的通谕中，教宗将人工智能与“巴别塔”进行了比较，这是一个警示故事，出现在《创世纪》的第一卷中，讲述了一个试图建造一座通往天堂的塔的故事，目的是为了确保稳定和权力，但却让上帝感到不满。教宗写道：“非人化——建立一个排斥上帝，并将他人视为工具的未来——是一种古老而又不断出现的诱惑，如今它以一种技术的形式出现。”In his May encyclical, the pope drew comparisons to the Tower of Babel, a cautionary tale that appears in the first Book of Genesis around an effort to build a tower that reached to the heavens in a bid to guarantee stability and power that displeased God. "The risk of dehumanization—of building a future that excludes God and reduces the other to a means—is an ancient and ever-new temptation that today takes on a technical guise," the pope wrote.

巴别塔：《创世纪》中人类建造通天塔、语言被变乱的叙事，常被用来警告僭越的权力工程。Tower of Babel: the Genesis story of a tower to heaven and confused languages, often invoked as a warning against hubristic power.

此后，教宗一直对此保持关注，包括在社交媒体平台X上，人工智能的开发者们就此展开了激烈的辩论。Since then, the pope hasn't let up, including on social-media platform X where a robust debate is playing out among AI's creators.

实验室的划界The Labs Draw a Line

也许这就是为什么最近，OpenAI的首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼试图将他的公司与纽约时报的一份报告区分开来，该报告称，竞争对手Anthropic曾试图游说梵蒂冈改变其对人工智能是否可能具有意识的看法，但最终未能成功。Maybe that's why in recent days, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman tried to distance his company from a report by the New York Times that rival Anthropic unsuccessfully lobbied the Vatican to change its views on whether AI could have a consciousness.

奥特曼几天前在X上发帖说：“我非常不赞成有人试图将宗教力量或放弃人类判断力赋予人工智能模型，我认为这是一个真正的安全问题。”"I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models, and think it is a real safety issue," Altman posted on X a weekend ago.

那些提出担忧的人不能简单地被视为反对技术进步的人。许多宗教领袖表示，他们希望引导这项技术，确保它对人类有益，而不是造成危害。[印刷版在此处内容不完整；同一文章的网络版将以下引文归于美国福音派协会主席沃尔特·金：]“宗教界之所以开始关注此事，是因为他们逐渐意识到，这项技术实际上正在解决……不仅是当前社会面临的重大问题，而且还在引发一个更宏大的问题，即‘作为人类意味着什么’？”Those raising concerns can't be dismissed as simply Luddites. Many faith leaders say they are hoping to steer the technology to ensure it is beneficial to humanity—not harmful. [Print edition is fragmented here; web edition of the same article attributes the following to Walter Kim, president of the National Association of Evangelicals:] "There's a reason why the faith community is having a moment because they're beginning to see that this is a technology that is actually addressing…not only the consequential horizontal societal issues that are at stake, but it's actually raising the larger question of what does it mean to be human?"

在南卡罗来纳州最近的一次周日布道中，哈钦森的Siri语音助手从他的iPhone中发出声音，他将人工智能的所有监控方面与《启示录》中的末日景象联系起来。During that recent Sunday sermon in South Carolina, Hutchinson's Siri assistant squawked from his iPhone as he connected how all of the surveillance aspects of AI would be powerful in Revelation's apocalypse.

在人工智能方面，这位牧师希望它能找到治疗疾病的惊人方法，并且他同意特朗普总统的观点，即美国不应放慢发展速度，以免让中国领先。When it comes to AI, the pastor is hopeful it will find amazing cures for illnesses and he agrees with President Trump that America shouldn't slow down development at the risk of letting China get ahead.

他只是认为，这项技术正在创造一种力量，他告诫他的信徒要记住，这种力量可能会被滥用。It's just that he also sees a power being created, which he cautioned his flock to remember, could be misused.

他说：“我看到了它在未来可能带来的影响，这并没有让我感到害怕，但它让我为那些尚未做好准备的人感到担忧。”"I see what it's leading to in the future and that doesn't scare me, but it bothers me for the other people that aren't ready," he said.

[照片说明：教宗良十四世在五月份的通谕中将人工智能与巴别塔进行了比较。（梵蒂冈媒体/法新社/盖蒂图片社）][Photo caption: Pope Leo XIV drew comparisons between AI and the Tower of Babel in his May encyclical. (Vatican Media/AFP/Getty Images)]

U.S. News · A2 版 · P3U.S. News · A2 版 · P3

委内瑞拉涉嫌行贿者被捕Venezuelan Bribe Suspect Arrested

经编辑审查 · 保持克制，未增加辅助模块 · 对照版Editorially reviewed · restraint, no aids · baseline

一名在美国被通缉的商人，他被指控向委内瑞拉高级官员行贿，以换取在委内瑞拉获得有利可图的政府合同，已被拘留。A businessman wanted in the U.S. for allegedly paying bribes to top Venezuelan officials in exchange for lucrative state contracts in Venezuela has been taken into custody.

阿尔瓦罗·普利多于2019年和2021年在迈阿密联邦法院被起诉，这是对他的长期商业伙伴阿莱克斯·萨博的调查的一部分。阿莱克斯·萨博曾是现已被罢免的总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的盟友。Alvaro Pulido was indicted in Miami federal court in 2019 and again in 2021 as part of an investigation into his longtime business partner, Alex Saab, a onetime ally of ousted President Nicolás Maduro.

■
